title: calymmanthera filiformis
intro: Calymmanthera filiformis, commonly known as the "Slipper Orchid", is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Calymmanthera filiformis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, reducing fever, and treating respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Calymmanthera filiformis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
